items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries. Continue read-only evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and private launch gates. Record dated evidence, scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. No new production work, duplicate telemetry, credential access, permission changes, configuration changes, dependency additions, deployments, requeues, or external outreach are authorized by this pass.
